documents.title: Bicycle returns
documents.text: The bicycle shop accepts returns within thirty days when the receipt is available. Refunds go to the original payment method.

documents.title: Bicycle frame warranty
documents.text: The bicycle frame has a two year warranty. Tire punctures and ordinary wear are excluded.

documents.title: Harbor train timetable
documents.text: The first harbor train departs the depot at 06:20 on weekdays. The final departure is at 22:40.

documents.title: Harbor ferry timetable
documents.text: The harbor ferry departs Pier Seven at 07:10 and 18:30. Bicycles are allowed aboard the ferry.

documents.title: Solar installation rebate
documents.text: Households installing rooftop solar panels may claim a 1500 dollar rebate after inspection.

documents.title: Attic insulation rebate
documents.text: The attic insulation rebate is 400 dollars. Keep the contractor invoice for the application.

documents.title: Horario de la biblioteca
documents.text: La biblioteca del barrio abre los martes hasta las 18:00. Los domingos permanece cerrada.

documents.title: Eventos de la biblioteca
documents.text: La biblioteca organiza un taller de escritura los jueves a las 17:00. La inscripción es gratuita.

documents.title: 地震訓練の予定
documents.text: 学校の地震訓練は金曜日の午前九時に始まります。参加者は校庭に集合します。

documents.title: 避難経路の案内
documents.text: 避難経路は西門から公園へ続きます。大雨の場合は体育館を集合場所にします。

documents.title: Horaires du musée
documents.text: Le musée ouvre le mercredi à 10 h et ferme à 19 h. Il est fermé le lundi.

documents.title: Billets du musée
documents.text: Les billets du musée coûtent douze euros. La réservation en ligne est recommandée.

documents.title: Orchard irrigation schedule
documents.text: Water the apple orchard at dawn every third day during the dry season. Check soil moisture first.

documents.title: Orchard harvest schedule
documents.text: Harvest the apple orchard in late September. Sort damaged fruit before packing.

documents.title: Workspace key rotation
documents.text: Rotate workspace access keys every ninety days. Revoke the old key after clients acknowledge the new key.

documents.title: Workspace backup policy
documents.text: Create an encrypted workspace backup every Friday. Test restoration once each quarter.
